scope: Primary-source reference pages; not code audits or a benchmark leaderboard. See docs for exact execution evidence.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS
entries.opportunity: Text-designed original voices, reusable reference conditioning and multilingual character speech.
entries.caveat: Select VoiceDesign, CustomVoice or Base deliberately; their interfaces differ. CUDA examples are not a Radeon benchmark.

entries.title: IndexTTS 2.5
entries.opportunity: Separate speaker/emotion references plus pronunciation and duration-factor controls.
entries.caveat: August 2026 release differs from IndexTTS2; Japanese Kana controls are relevant. Exact clip-length guarantees are not assumed.

entries.title: VoxCPM2
entries.opportunity: 48kHz multilingual voice design/cloning; investigate the linked split llama.cpp-omni path.
entries.caveat: Backend and quantization need separate local evidence; the standard Python path has version requirements.

entries.title: MOSS-TTS family
entries.opportunity: Small Nano, dialogue, voice-design, realtime and controllable local speech candidates.
entries.caveat: These are separate bundles, not modes guaranteed in one checkpoint. Avoid borrowing a Nano memory figure for a larger model.

entries.title: Fish Audio S2-Pro
entries.opportunity: Expressive multi-speaker dialogue candidate with inline delivery tags.
entries.caveat: Fish Audio Research License: commercial use requires the relevant separate agreement. Not a default MIT candidate.

entries.title: Chatterbox / Turbo
entries.opportunity: Smaller expressive voice and paralinguistic reactions; multilingual model is a distinct choice.
entries.caveat: Retain built-in PerTh provenance watermark. Benchmark actual language/variant rather than generic family marketing.

entries.title: Kokoro 82M
entries.opportunity: Small baseline for preview narration and batch-feasibility comparison.
entries.caveat: Model card terms and voices are distinct inputs; not the same expressive control as voice-design models.

entries.title: Piper maintained engine
entries.opportunity: CPU-friendly fallback and deterministic operational baseline.
entries.caveat: GPL engine and individual voice terms are separate. Test language and pronunciation for the chosen voice.

entries.title: CosyVoice3 family
entries.opportunity: Independent speech-generation comparison lane.
entries.caveat: Resolve the exact released bundle and runtime before prescribing settings.

entries.title: ACE-Step1.5 / XL
entries.opportunity: Local composition, editing and reference-guided music; documented AMD route.
entries.caveat: Base, SFT and Turbo feature matrices differ. XL 4B is not the low-memory small default.

entries.title: Stable Audio3 Small SFX
entries.opportunity: Sound generation, audio editing and continuation candidate.
entries.caveat: Gated Community/T5Gemma terms. Inference checkpoint and -base training checkpoint are not interchangeable.

entries.title: MOSS SoundEffect2
entries.opportunity: Dedicated text-to-sound effects branch in the MOSS family.
entries.caveat: Use its own model/runtime profile, not the TTS adapter contract.

entries.title: MMAudio
entries.opportunity: Video/text conditioned Foley and scene sound.
entries.caveat: MIT code does not override CC-BY-NC checkpoint terms; synced candidates still need event timing review.

entries.title: HunyuanVideo-Foley
entries.opportunity: Alternative video-conditioned sound generation.
entries.caveat: Review this exact release and runtime; carry user authorisations at their actual scope rather than company-wide assumptions.

entries.title: SAM Audio
entries.opportunity: Text/visual/span-directed source separation into target and residual.
entries.caveat: Gated model terms; separation is not generation or recovery of the original multitrack.

entries.title: DeepFilterNet
entries.opportunity: Speech cleanup comparison before voice-reference ingestion.
entries.caveat: Over-cleaning can change timbre; preserve raw reference and compare.

entries.title: Spotify Pedalboard
entries.opportunity: Scriptable DSP and plugin-based offline effects.
entries.caveat: Plugins and project distribution have separate terms; persist exact plugin identity and settings.

entries.title: Qwen3-ASR and ForcedAligner
entries.opportunity: Transcription and a separate text/audio alignment branch.
entries.caveat: ASR, alignment and diarization are different tasks; forced text agreement cannot prove transcription accuracy.

entries.title: faster-whisper
entries.opportunity: CPU/int8 transcription baseline for generated dialogue checks.
entries.caveat: Its documented GPU path is CTranslate2/CUDA, not automatically ROCm because Torch works.

entries.title: WhisperX
entries.opportunity: Word alignment and optional diarization orchestration.
entries.caveat: Language aligners and speaker models are extra dependencies/terms.

entries.title: Rhubarb Lip Sync
entries.opportunity: CLI mouth-cue JSON to drive drawn mouth states or mapped avatar expressions.
entries.caveat: Approximate cues require authored mappings and language review; not a full facial-performance capture system.

entries.title: OpenVPI DiffSinger
entries.opportunity: Note/phoneme/pitch-oriented singing synthesis with editable performance controls.
entries.caveat: Voicebank and dataset terms remain separate from Apache code.

entries.title: OpenUtau
entries.opportunity: Editable singing project alongside compatible synthesis engines.
entries.caveat: A generated mixed song is not this editable score/voicebank representation.

entries.title: Kenney Interface Sounds
entries.opportunity: Creator-published CC0 interface sounds for fast usable UI assets.
entries.caveat: Keep per-pack source records; no need to synthesize every click.

entries.title: REAPER ReaScript
entries.opportunity: Native DAW scripting and proper track/bus/effect work.
entries.caveat: Use an appropriately licensed installed application; native project is not losslessly represented by a tiny JSON timeline.

entries.title: Audacity scripting
entries.opportunity: Named-pipe automation for batch audio edits.
entries.caveat: Requires a running suitable project; protect native files and restrict broad scripting access.

entries.title: Audacity project-window scripting issue
entries.opportunity: Concrete lifecycle-fault test for an editor bridge.
entries.caveat: An open issue report, not a universal diagnosis; test installed-version behavior.

entries.title: OpenTimelineIO
entries.opportunity: Editorial timeline interchange with explicit time and media references.
entries.caveat: Not a renderer; effects, audio buses and native-project round trips can be lossy.

entries.title: FFmpeg filters
entries.opportunity: Deterministic cut, transition, overlay, gain, fade and mix render target.
entries.caveat: Version/capability-test actual filters; only a bounded supported subset is implemented here.

entries.title: Official MCP Python SDK2.2
entries.opportunity: Typed tools using current SDK rather than an invented wire protocol.
entries.caveat: Local pip failed due to DNS; real stdio testing is delegated to dedicated CI until evidence arrives.

entries.title: Blender MCP
entries.opportunity: Broader exploratory agent control and viewport feedback.
entries.caveat: Audit broad execute-code and optional external integrations; no unrestricted eval in the narrow production adapter.

entries.title: VRM Add-on for Blender
entries.opportunity: Anime avatar import/export and humanoid metadata.
entries.caveat: Pin Blender/addon/VRM versions; arbitrary export must not silently lose MToon, spring bones or expressions.

entries.title: VRM Animation
entries.opportunity: Humanoid motion/expression interchange for compatible avatars.
entries.caveat: Different bodies still need contact/proportion review; inspect target runtime support.

entries.title: VRoid Studio guidelines
entries.opportunity: Create original anime avatars with editable designs and explicit preset rules.
entries.caveat: Not all samples/presets are CC0; read the specific preset and third-party hair/clothes terms.

entries.title: VRoid sample models
entries.opportunity: Concrete starting models accessible inside VRoid Studio.
entries.caveat: Account/application actions remain local; no binary downloads or licence acceptance in this pass.

entries.title: VRoidPreset A-Z usage
entries.opportunity: A specifically documented anime base-model family for modification experiments.
entries.caveat: Use these exact terms, not the licence of an older beta sample.

entries.title: Quaternius Universal Base Characters
entries.opportunity: CC0 humanoid bases and compatible stylized assets.
entries.caveat: Free Standard is a subset; full counts and editable Source-tier files are not all free.

entries.title: Quaternius Fantasy Outfits
entries.opportunity: Compatible modular fantasy clothing for base characters.
entries.caveat: Select exact free/paid tier and skeleton version.

entries.title: Universal Animation Library Standard
entries.opportunity: Author-published free CC0 Standard pack with45 motions.
entries.caveat: Full120+ collection is a different tier; preserve actual archive version and clip list.

entries.title: Universal Animation Library2 Standard
entries.opportunity: Author-published free animation expansion candidate.
entries.caveat: Do not advertise full130+ library as the free subset.

entries.title: June2026 root-motion update
entries.opportunity: Updated root-motion/in-place and directional-loop matching.
entries.caveat: Old downloaded archives may not contain current _RM clips.

entries.title: Blender Studio Rain v3
entries.opportunity: Creator-issued full animation practice rig, CC-BY, Blender4.1+.
entries.caveat: Keep credits; inspect embedded rig scripts before explicitly trusting them.

entries.title: Blender Studio Snow v4
entries.opportunity: Second creator-issued animation rig for body/face performance comparisons.
entries.caveat: Version-specific Blender and rig requirements; not a ready game-export skeleton.

entries.title: Blender Studio Storm
entries.opportunity: Newer expressive practice rig and pose-library research lead.
entries.caveat: Requires Blender5.0 according to author page; confirm actual download access and terms.

entries.title: Adobe Mixamo FAQ
entries.opportunity: Humanoid auto-rigging and character motions through Adobe ID.
entries.caveat: Hosted upload boundary; animation in a project differs from redistributing the source library standalone.

entries.title: Godot audio buses
entries.opportunity: Game-time dialogue/music/effect routing and environmental effects.
entries.caveat: Web Sample vs Stream playback has effect-support tradeoffs; test target platform.
